name: readme-name-guardrail
description: Deterministic PreToolUse guardrail: denies creating a 'readme.md' (any capitalization) anywhere but the project root, and denies git add/commit of one, so the codebase keeps a single unambiguous README instead of dozens of same-named files crowding terminal file references. Rename with a descriptive prefix (e.g. creatures-readme.md). No LLM judgment. Claude Code only.
